page.overview:
Who is Eighth Heroine?

The is a rumored eighth member of the . The Heroines are known as the divine protectors of the people. The is still worshiped by those faithful to her. Although massive statues of the can be found at the , the is found in the northern . This Statue plays a role in the , "", given by . Though the was wiped from history and is not proven to exist, sends in search of its Statue. After shows a picture of the Statue, he can receive another from titled "", where must find the Statue's missing Sword on the southeastern section of .

During the "", it is revealed the was actually an ancient Hylian who roused the against a great evil and saved the Gerudo people, but afterwards was forbidden from entering Gerudo Town due to the law prohibiting a man's entry. The Gerudo would later regret this fact, and as penance, subsumed the Hylian into the , with the truth eventually becoming lost to time.
